notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Malevolent Rumble, causing you to mill four cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
